productSignatureCandidates.uncertainty: High: requires demonstration that EV-associated activity replicates across lots and predicts short-interval ex vivo modulation after intranasal dosing.
productSignatureCandidates.measurement_concept: Orthogonal capture + particle co-localization + detergent/protease protection combined with ex vivo cytokine readout after short-interval in vivo exposure.

productSignatureCandidates.name: EV identity and purity

productSignatureCandidates.uncertainty: Moderate
productSignatureCandidates.measurement_concept: Orthogonal capture co-localization with particle peaks + spike-in-protected recovery + detergent/protease sensitivity

productSignatureCandidates.name: Pre-SEC-depleted bounded small-EV fraction: orthogonal intact-EV signature + manufacturable yield
productSignatureCandidates.rationale: A process-derived bounded fraction that preserves membrane-protected capture-positive co-localization and provides acceptable recovery would serve as a drug-substance candidate enabling downstream QC and potency linkage.
productSignatureCandidates.uncertainty: High: process impact on membrane integrity and yield is uncertain until experimentally tested.
productSignatureCandidates.measurement_concept: Qualitative co-localization of particle-count peaks with capture-positive fractions; detergent/protease-sensitive captured signal; qualitative recovery (mass and particle) sufficient for preliminary GMP-batch considerations.

productSignatureCandidates.name: Downstream-process compatibility: preservation of orthogonal intact-EV analytical signature
productSignatureCandidates.rationale: A process-stage acceptance attribute defined qualitatively by preservation of capture-positive co-localization with particle peaks and detergent/protease sensitivity after downstream processing exposures; intended to gate permissible downstream handling and formulation choices.
productSignatureCandidates.uncertainty: Moderate: dependent on assay robustness and reproducibility across lots.
productSignatureCandidates.measurement_concept: Qualitative intact-EV signature preservation (pass/fail) assessed by co-localization and protection assays; not a numeric release test.

productSignatureCandidates.name: EV identity and purity
productSignatureCandidates.rationale: Concentration/process step is hypothesized to be the scale-sensitive control that determines preservation of the orthogonal intact-EV identity signature required by MISEV2023 and program CMC needs; testing this will define a qualitative process gate for identity.
productSignatureCandidates.uncertainty: Moderate: if assay controls fail or upstream variability dominates, attribute's role as scale-control may be limited.
productSignatureCandidates.measurement_concept: Orthogonal intact-EV analytic panel post-concentration (capture co-localization with particle peak; detergent/protease sensitivity; protein:particle ratio).

productSignatureCandidates.name: Protected-cargo composite fingerprint (panel-level, qualitative)
productSignatureCandidates.rationale: A small, predefined panel of protected miRNAs and detergent/protease-sensitive luminal proteins measured on capture-positive, particle-peak fractions enables a practical, lot-level qualitative gate distinguishing EV-associated cargo from secretome co-isolates without presuming a single active molecule.
productSignatureCandidates.uncertainty: Moderate: panel selection is operator-dependent and sensitivity in low-biomass capture fractions is uncertain.
productSignatureCandidates.measurement_concept: Qualitative presence/absence of each panel member in capture-positive particle-peak fractions and qualitative loss after detergent+protease treatment (membrane protection).

nodes.statement: If a membrane-protected, capture-positive particle fraction contains a reproducible composite of protected miRNAs and detergent/protease-sensitive luminal proteins across independent lots, then that composite is an EV-associated cargo fingerprint distinct from variable secretome co-isolates.

If the composite fingerprint is absent or inconsistent across lots or is detergent-insensitive, then observed cargo signals likely reflect non-vesicular secretome co-isolates or assay artifacts and cannot be used to gate lots as EV-enriched.

edges.uncertainty: Moderate: guidance supports protected-cargo linkage to EV identity; rodent efficacy shows activity but does not define protected cargo; detection in larger species remains uncertain.
edges.competing_explanation: Apparent protected-cargo conservation could reflect consistent co-isolation of abundant soluble complexes or assay cross-reactivity rather than true EV-protected cargo.
edges.missing_experiment: Cross-lot protected-cargo profiling on immuno-captured particle-peak fractions with detergent/protease controls and spike-in controls to exclude assay bias.

proposedExperiment.question: Does a small, predefined protected-cargo panel (3–6 miRNAs + 2–4 luminal proteins) reproducibly occur in immuno-capture-positive, particle-peak fractions across >=3 independent production lots and is that signal membrane-protected (lost after detergent + protease/RNase)?
proposedExperiment.hypothesis_tested: A focused protected-cargo composite fingerprint (selected protected miRNAs + detergent/protease-sensitive luminal proteins) will be reproducibly detected in capture-positive particle-peak fractions across independent lots and will be substantially reduced or abolished after detergent + protease/RNase treatment, whereas concentrated conditioned-medium controls will lack this protected fingerprint or show detergent-insensitive signals.
required_material: >=3 independent conditioned-medium production lots from the same source-cell bank/passage range processed identically
Immuno-capture reagents for intact EV surface markers (anti-CD63, anti-CD9, anti-CD81 or TIM4/AnxA5)
Particle counter (NTA or TRPS) and reagents
Density-gradient (iodixanol) or SEC fractionation materials and fraction collectors
Exogenous intact-EV spike-in tracer (orthogonal species or isotope-labeled) for assay recovery controls
Protease (proteinase K), RNase reagents and detergent (Triton X-100 or equivalent) for membrane-disruption controls
Reagents for targeted small-RNA measurement (RT-qPCR or targeted sequencing) with spike-in controls
Targeted proteomics reagents (SRM/PRM) for selected luminal proteins and appropriate standards
Total protein assay reagents and consumables
proposedExperiment.comparator: Per-lot matched pair: (A) bounded, capture-positive particle-peak fractions (from enriched small-EV workflow) versus (B) concentrated conditioned-medium (secretome-retaining) fractions processed identically; both spiked with exogenous tracer prior to fractionation. Include detergent+protease-treated aliquots for each fraction.
proposedExperiment.control: Positive control: characterized small EV preparation processed in parallel and spike-in tracer recovery; Negative controls: buffer-only fractions and detergent-disrupted samples. Spike-in tracer used to confirm fraction-level assay recovery.
proposedExperiment.assay: Orthogonal fraction-level workflow: (1) fractionate sample (density/SEC) and record particle counts per fraction; (2) immuno-capture on intact, particle-peak fractions and eluate capture material; (3) split eluates ± detergent + protease/RNase and perform targeted miRNA panel assays and targeted proteomics on each split; (4) measure total protein and compute protein:particle context for fractions; (5) evaluate spike-in tracer recovery in same fractions.
proposedExperiment.primary_readout: Qualitative presence/absence call for the protected-cargo panel members in capture-positive, particle-peak fractions across >=3 lots, AND qualitative loss (present -> absent or substantially reduced) of those signals after detergent + protease/RNase treatment in the same fractions.
secondary_readouts: Spike-in tracer recovery and membrane-protection behavior per fraction (validates assay recovery)
Protein:particle ratio differences between bounded fractions and secretome controls
proposedExperiment.success_criterion: Qualitative success: In >=3 independent production lots, the bounded capture-positive particle-peak fractions reproducibly show the predefined protected-cargo panel (presence of >=3 miRNA panel members and >=1 luminal protein panel member) and these signals are substantially reduced or abolished after detergent + protease/RNase treatment; concentrated secretome-retaining controls lack this protected pattern or show detergent-insensitive signals. Spike-in tracer recovery confirms assay performance.
proposedExperiment.failure_criterion: If spike-in controls validate assay recovery but endogenous protected-cargo panel members are absent or not detergent/protease-sensitive in capture-positive fractions across >=3 lots, the hypothesis is falsified and the material should be treated as lacking a reproducible EV-associated cargo fingerprint for lot gating.
proposedExperiment.falsification_outcome: If falsified, the program must not use the protected-cargo fingerprint as an EV-associated lot gate, and should revert to alternative fractionation, tighter source-cell controls, or secretome-centric product definitions while re-evaluating panel selection and assay sensitivity.
dependencies: Availability of >=3 independent production lots with sufficient yield
Validated capture reagents and particle-count instrumentation
Access to targeted miRNA and targeted proteomics platforms with spike-in normalization capability
Pre-validated buffer-compatibility and spike-in recovery controls

molecularAtlas.contribution_headline: Contribute to the Signal Molecular Atlas
molecularAtlas.contribution_description: Share well-annotated EV and secretome datasets to help evaluate reproducible product signatures and generate testable hypotheses.

contribution_fields.label: Dataset and assay type
contribution_fields.help_text: For example RNA-seq, proteomics, lipidomics, surface profiling, or potency.

contribution_fields.label: Sample provenance
contribution_fields.help_text: Species, tissue or cell source, donor context, and cohort structure.

contribution_fields.label: Process metadata
contribution_fields.help_text: Culture, conditioning, harvest, isolation, storage, lot, and batch information.

contribution_fields.label: Methods and controls
contribution_fields.help_text: Protocols, platform, replicates, controls, normalization, and QC.

contribution_fields.label: Consent, access, and reuse rights
contribution_fields.help_text: Data-use limitations, participant consent, license, and desired attribution.

contribution_fields.label: Repository accession or dataset description
contribution_fields.help_text: Register metadata first; do not upload files or participant data here.

molecularAtlas.prohibited_submission: Do not submit patient identifiers, protected health information, credentials, confidential files, or human-level omics through the public website.
